title: Sweet Italian Pea Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with tender peas and Italian seasonings. Perfect for a quick snack or light lunch.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Add kissed oil and swirl to coat.
Add sweet peas and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle italian seasoning and salt to taste.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the pea mixture inside.
